plan: [This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid your private value) is a weakly dominant strategy and maximizes expected payoff. No history to learn from in round 1, so bid my value of $10. ]

[This is a single-round, sealed-bid second-price auction. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: you pay the second-highest bid if you win, so bidding your private value maximizes expected profit regardless of other bidders. No prior history to exploit and values redraw independently each round. Tie-breaking is random but doesn't change optimality. Therefore bid exactly your value of $30. ]

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy. Bidding 25 maximizes expected profit: you win whenever the highest opponent bid is below 25 and pay the second-highest bid, yielding value minus price. Use a bid of 25.0 (0.1 increment OK).]
